Name: AdvancedKeyBindings
Author: Drachenkatze
Description:
Adds several key bindings to assist with common game functions, targeted at players using a Gamepad.

Currently implemented key bindings:
[list]
[*]Chests: Add to existing stacks
[*]Building Placement: Quick Pan screen up/down/left/right
[*]Building Upgrade or Demolishing: Quick Pan screen up/down/left/right, select previous/next suitable building for upgrading/demolishing
[*]Animal Placement: Quick Pan screen up/down/left/right, select previous/next suitable building for the animal
[/list]How to use:
[list]
[*]Start the game
[*]Open the [code]config.json[/code] file and adjust the keys
[/list]
Contribute:
[list]
[*]Add bug reports and feature requests to the [url=https://github.com/Drachenkaetzchen/AdvancedKeyBindings/issues]GitHub project page[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Source Code at [url=https://github.com/Drachenkaetzchen/AdvancedKeyBindings]https://github.com/Drachenkaetzchen/AdvancedKeyBindings[/url]
[/list]
